- [TS3011a:03:16] The group will design a trendy, original and user-friendly remote control.
- [TS3011a:11:39] The remote control will be sold for 25 euros with a profit aim of 50 million euros.
- [TS3011a:11:59] The remote will be sold internationally.
- [TS3011a:12:09] The production costs should be no more than 12.50 euros.
- [TS3011a:17:17] The remote will control multiple devices. (replaces a television-only remote)
- [TS3011a:17:31] The remote will be sold directly to individual consumers rather than companies.
- [TS3011b:10:13] LED's can be used to light up the remote.
- [TS3011b:11:07] Using them sparsely, as in mobile phones, could bring down the cost.
- [TS3011b:16:50] It would be a good idea to integrate a mechanism for finding the remote control, when the user loses it.
- [TS3011b:17:32] The latter would be preferable to implementing a backlight into the remote.
- [TS3011b:21:58] A single, large, round button can be used for both volume and channel selection by using the four separate quadrants.
- [TS3011b:24:50] Another button to switch between two channels could also be implemented.
- [TS3011b:27:43] The remote will also include volume and program selection, and speech recognition.
- [TS3011b:29:47] A recharging cradle can be added to compensate for the extra energy consumption.
- [TS3011c:07:12] Changeable covers for the remote control can link the product to current fashion trends, but also trends followed by other age groups.
- [TS3011c:26:44] A scroll wheel will be included in the design.
- [TS3011c:30:09] A single-curved rubber casing can also be used.
- [TS3011c:26:48] LCD is not going to be implemented. (replaces an LCD screen)
- [TS3011c:30:17] The preferred energy source was a combination of batteries and solar cells.
